output.title: Supported browsers
output.content: The web app officially supports the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari. Internet Explorer is not supported. Some layout issues may appear on unsupported browsers.

output.title: Exporting reports to PDF (macOS)
output.content: On macOS, the in-app 'Export to PDF' button can crash the app on some versions. Workaround: use File > Print, then choose 'Save as PDF' from the system print dialog instead of the in-app export button. A permanent fix is planned but not yet released.

output.title: API rate limits
output.content: The API allows 100 requests per minute on the Free and Pro plans, and 1000 requests per minute on the Enterprise plan. Exceeding the limit returns an HTTP 429 response with a Retry-After header.

steps.rawOutput:
Thank you for reaching out. According to our documentation, we officially support the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari. Opera isn't listed among our officially supported browsers at this time.

That said, you may still be able to use our service with Opera, though we can't guarantee full compatibility. You might experience some layout issues or other unexpected behavior since we haven't tested or optimized for that browser.

If you do encounter any specific problems while using Opera with our service, please let us know what you're experiencing and we'd be happy to help troubleshoot. If there are particular features or compatibility requirements that are important for your team, I'd encourage you to submit that feedback as a feature request so we can consider it for future updates.
